text:
Nina: Quick thread to align on the micro-beta plan (smaller than alpha) — goal: fast signal on routing, cost controls, and feedback tooling. Thinking 5 partners, 3-week run. Who can own outreach and the intake scorecard?

Carlos: I can own outreach + shortlist. Ops constraints: prefer hosted routes; avoid dedicated infra unless critical. Keep integrations to 1-2 deep.

Mei: I'll design the intake scorecard. Proposal: 4 axes (fit, responsiveness, infra-friction, metric-signal) scored 1-5. Weight fit 40%, responsiveness 30%, infra 20%, metric 10%.

Jon: Eng: telemetry needs to be tiny. Suggested events: ping_start, prompt_hash, route, latency_ms, verdict (ok/flag). We'll provide a copy-paste curl snippet for partners. Example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/telemetry -d '{"event":"latency_ms","value":210,"route":"/v1/chat"}'
```

Nina: Outreach window: 5 days. Acceptance cap: 5 partners (3 sandbox, 2 integrations). Commitment: 3 weeks active + weekly 30m syncs. Async: Looms + short 6-question survey mid-run.

Carlos: Incentives: $200 credits + early feature triage for integration partners. Keep admin low.

Mei: Acceptance SLA: partner must confirm within 72h or we reallocate. Also add a quick exclusion rule: if infra needs VPC peering/on-prem, move to private track and exclude from micro-beta.

Jon: Operational guardrails: reserve 0.5 dev-day per integration for onboarding. Routing: route partners to our small hosted variant first; fallback to larger instance only if latency > threshold on 2 consecutive days.

Nina: Success metrics (pass/fail): 1) onboarding completion >=80% within 48h, 2) median latency improvement/ degradation logged, 3) at least 2 product-ask tickets across cohort by week 3.

Carlos: Small ask on telemetry: include `session_id` in payloads so we can correlate across events. Also add `feedback_tag` with short values (ui, hallucination, latency).

Jon: Good call. Example minimal payload (as a shell-quoted string in the packet) so partners can copy: '{"event":"prompt","session_id":"<uuid>","route":"/v1/generate","latency_ms":180,"feedback_tag":"ui"}'

Mei: I'll produce the intake spreadsheet and a one-line guide for reviewers (what a 5 or 1 means on each axis). That should keep scoring consistent across CS/sales reviewers.

legal-bot: Reminder: integration track partners require NDA + DPA. Legal will pre-seed a 1-page agreement; expect 48-72h review.

Nina: Action items: - Carlos: shortlist + outreach copy by Wed; - Mei: intake template + scoring guide by Tue; - Jon: telemetry example + 1-page runbook by Tue; - Legal: NDA/DPA one-pager by Wed. I'll schedule a 20m kickoff next Fri.

Carlos: I'll also include a 5-prompt sample set in the invite so partners know the edge cases we care about.

Jon: Add a regression trigger: if any partner sees a >25% increase in 5xxs or sustained 2x latency for 6h, we open an urgent triage and consider pausing that partner.

Mei: I'll include a tiny QA checklist partners run before first check-in: 1) run sample prompts, 2) verify telemetry delivered for 10 sessions, 3) attach 2 failure screenshots or Looms.

Nina: Sounds good. If no objections, we'll lock the shortlist Wednesday and send invites Thursday morning. Ping here if you need scope changes.
